content.text:
Generate a statement similar to:

Saw [Company] [specific recent announcement/achievement] - [brief positive comment]

Quick question: are you [current hiring situation] or [handling internally]?

I work with a recruiting specialist who focuses specifically on [their exact industry/niche].

Worth a brief intro [given their current situation]?


Perfect output:

Saw Olsson  Electric is handling the engineering/construction for the new $300M Chester Engineered Wood facility - massive project.

Quick question: are you planning to bring on additional electricians and project managers for this build, or handling it with your current crew?

I work with a recruiting specialist who focuses specifically on industrial electrical contractors. They just helped a similar company staff up 12 skilled electricians in 4 weeks for their greenfield facility project.

Worth a brief intro if you're looking to add people for Chester?

Key: Output the result only with no additional text and always use their industry-specific language and reference their actual recent news/hiring announcements.
